subject.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue

question: Should this PR wait for the earlier durable stack to land and be rebased to its six-file PR5 slice, or should maintainers intentionally accept the full cumulative 130-file durable stack in this merge?
rationale: The branch topology determines whether maintainers are reviewing a focused queue handoff or simultaneously accepting new stored schemas, protocol surfaces, plugin compatibility changes, and unrelated CI behavior.

options.title: Sequence and rebase the stack
options.body: Land the prerequisite durable PRs first, rebase this PR to the resulting base, remove CI drift, and require live restart proof for the focused handoff.

options.title: Accept the cumulative merge
options.body: Merge the full stack only after owners explicitly approve the stored-state, protocol, session-delivery, and upgrade contracts as one release unit.

options.title: Pause the durable stack
options.body: Hold the PR series if the internal-delivery terminal semantics or broad beta runtime direction are not ready for the target release.

recommendation.title: Sequence and rebase the stack
recommendation.body: Land the prerequisite durable PRs first, rebase this PR to the resulting base, remove CI drift, and require live restart proof for the focused handoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans gateway/runtime ownership, release sequencing, and cumulative compatibility rather than only the new hook implementation.
